[Back to all emotions](index.qmd)

Disgust can help us move away from something unsafe, harmful, or deeply against our values.

## It can give us the urge to

- reject;
- move away; or
- protect ourselves.

## It may be telling us

- something may be unsafe;
- something may be harmful; or
- a value may have been violated.

## What can help

1. Name the exact problem.
2. Check the evidence.
3. Step back if needed.
4. Reject harmful behaviour without dehumanizing people.

## Design connection

Clean geometry, cool colour, and clear type can signal order, control, and cleanliness.

**Examples:** Mr. Clean, CeraVe, and Lush.
